reference_sql:
WITH w AS (
  -- one row per product and week
  SELECT product_id, week_start, units,
    AVG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY week_start ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS avg_prev_4w
  FROM weekly_units
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 50
)
SELECT product_id, week_start, units, ROUND(avg_prev_4w, 2) AS avg_prev_4w
FROM w
WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND units >= 2
  AND units >= 2 * avg_prev_4w
alternatives:
SELECT w.product_id, w.week_start, w.units, ROUND(AVG(p.units), 2) AS avg_prev_4w
FROM weekly_units w
JOIN weekly_units p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  AND p.week_start BETWEEN w.week_start - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND w.week_start - INTERVAL 7 DAY
WHERE w.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 50
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND w.units >= 2
GROUP BY w.product_id, w.week_start, w.units
HAVING w.units >= 2 * AVG(p.units)

other_way.sql:
SELECT w.product_id, w.week_start, w.units, ROUND(AVG(p.units), 2) AS avg_prev_4w
FROM weekly_units w
JOIN weekly_units p ON p.product_id = w.product_id
  AND p.week_start BETWEEN w.week_start - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND w.week_start - INTERVAL 7 DAY
WHERE w.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 50
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND w.units >= 2
GROUP BY w.product_id, w.week_start, w.units
HAVING w.units >= 2 * AVG(p.units)
other_way.tradeoff: Joining each week to the 4 weeks before it finds the same spikes without a window, but only because every week has a row.

solver.query:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT product_id, CAST(week_start AS DATE) AS week_start, units,
         AVG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY CAST(week_start AS DATE) ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS a
  FROM weekly_units WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 50
)
SELECT product_id, week_start, units, ROUND(a, 2) AS avg_prev_4w
FROM x
WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-06-30' AND units >= 2 AND units >= 2 * a
